{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Calculate response rates for treatment and control groups
control_response_rate = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
treatment_response_rate = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()

# Compute the treatment effect as difference in proportions (treatment - control)
treatment_effect = treatment_response_rate - control_response_rate

# Print the results
treatment_effect, control_response_rate, treatment_response_rate"}
